description: Read one email: headers, labels, clean text body (HTML is converted to text) and attachment list (use read_attachment to read their contents). Pass the account shown in search results. If account is omitted, every connected account is tried.

account.description: Account alias or email address. Omit to use the default account. No accounts connected yet.

maxBodyChars.description: Truncate the body after this many characters (default 20000).

name: read_email
title: Read an email
